description: This file contains helper functions and data structures for integrating Stripe payments within a Django application, including creating charges, handling customer data, and finalizing orders.

classes.name: StripeChargeParams
classes.description: A data class representing parameters needed for creating a Stripe charge.

methods.name: str create_ref_code(*, length: int = 20)
methods.description: Generates a random reference code for an order.

methods.name: str ensure_stripe_customer_with_source( *, user: get_user_model(), userprofile: UserProfile, token: str, )
methods.description: Ensures a Stripe customer exists for the user and attaches a payment source; creates a new customer if necessary.

methods.name: dict create_stripe_charge(*, params: StripeChargeParams)
methods.description: Creates a charge via Stripe API using provided parameters.

methods.name: Payment finalize_successful_order( *, order: Order, user: get_user_model(), charge_id: str )
methods.description: Creates a Payment object for the order after successful payment and updates order status.

methods.name: list[dict] list_customer_cards(*, stripe_customer_id: str, limit: int = 3)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of saved credit cards for a Stripe customer.

ctags.name: ensure_stripe_customer_with_source
ctags.signature: ( *, user: get_user_model(), userprofile: UserProfile, token: str, )

ctags.name: finalize_successful_order
ctags.signature: ( *, order: Order, user: get_user_model(), charge_id: str )

ctags.name: list_customer_cards
ctags.pattern: /^def list_customer_cards(*, stripe_customer_id: str, limit: int = 3) -> list[dict]:$/
